mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_case (id, workspace_id, req_id, demand_id, case_no, title, precondition, test_data, module, module_id, priority, steps, sort_order, latest_status, latest_note, latest_by, latest_by_user_id, latest_at, latest_bug_task_id, created_by, created_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{demandId}, #{caseNo}, #{title}, #{precondition}, #{testData}, #{module}, #{moduleId}, #{priority}, #{steps}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), #{latestStatus}, #{latestNote}, #{latestBy}, #{latestByUserId}, #{latestAt}, #{latestBugTaskId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdByUserId}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE test_case SET req_id = #{reqId}, demand_id = #{demandId}, case_no = #{caseNo}, title = #{title}, precondition = #{precondition}, test_data = #{testData}, module = #{module}, module_id = #{moduleId}, priority = #{priority}, steps = #{steps}, sort_order = COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, sort_order) WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

UPDATE test_case SET latest_status = #{status}, latest_note = #{note}, latest_by = #{by}, latest_by_user_id = #{byUserId}, latest_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM test_case WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachment a WHERE a.target_kind = 'case_run' AND a.target_id = (SELECT r.id FROM test_case_run r WHERE r.case_id = c.id AND r.workspace_id = c.workspace_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1))
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.req_id, c.demand_id, d.title AS demand_title, c.case_no, c.title, c.precondition, c.test_data, c.module, c.module_id, c.priority, c.steps AS steps_json, c.latest_status, c.latest_note, c.latest_by, c.latest_at, c.latest_bug_task_id, t.title AS latest_bug_task_title, (CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS latest_bug_resolved, AS latest_evidence_count, c.created_by, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM test_case c LEFT JOIN demand d ON d.id = c.demand_id LEFT JOIN task t ON t.id = c.latest_bug_task_id WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.req_id = #{reqId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
SELECT latest_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM test_case WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId} AND latest_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY latest_status
mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task bt WHERE bt.id = c.latest_bug_task_id AND bt.workspace_id = c.workspace_id AND bt.deleted_at IS NULL AND bt.board_column <> 'done')
LEFT JOIN task bt ON bt.id = c.latest_bug_task_id AND bt.workspace_id = c.workspace_id AND bt.deleted_at IS NULL AND bt.board_column <> 'done'
FROM test_case c LEFT JOIN demand d ON d.id = c.demand_id LEFT JOIN task t ON t.id = c.latest_bug_task_id

sql.if: LEFT JOIN ( WITH RECURSIVE mo AS ( SELECT n.id AS id, CAST(LPAD(COALESCE(n.sort_order, 0), 6, '0') AS CHAR(512)) AS p, 1 AS d FROM category n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{q.workspaceId} AND n.project_id = #{q.reqId} AND (COALESCE(n.parent_id, '') = '' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM category p0 WHERE p0.id = n.parent_id AND p0.workspace_id = n.workspace_id AND p0.project_id = n.project_id)) UNION ALL SELECT n.id, CONCAT(mo.p, '/', LPAD(COALESCE(n.sort_order, 0), 6, '0')), mo.d + 1 FROM category n JOIN mo ON n.parent_id = mo.id WHERE mo.d < 64 AND n.workspace_id = #{q.workspaceId} AND n.project_id = #{q.reqId} ) SELECT id, p FROM mo ) mo ON mo.id = c.module_id

ORDER BY c.sort_order ORDER BY c.case_no ORDER BY FIELD(COALESCE(c.priority, '__none'), 'P0','P1','P2','P3','__none') ORDER BY c.latest_at ORDER BY c.updated_at
ORDER BY FIELD(COALESCE(c.latest_status, '__untested'), 'failed','blocked','passed','skipped','__untested')
ORDER BY COALESCE(mo.p, '999999')

SELECT c.id, c.req_id, c.demand_id, d.title AS demand_title, c.case_no, c.title, c.precondition, c.test_data, c.module, c.module_id, c.priority, c.steps AS steps_json, c.latest_status, c.latest_note, c.latest_by, c.latest_at, c.latest_bug_task_id, t.title AS latest_bug_task_title, (CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS latest_bug_resolved, AS latest_evidence_count, c.created_by, c.created_at, c.updated_at

SELECT c.id, c.req_id, c.demand_id, d.title AS demand_title, c.case_no, c.title, c.precondition, c.test_data, c.module, c.module_id, c.priority, c.steps AS steps_json, c.latest_status, c.latest_note, c.latest_by, c.latest_at, c.latest_bug_task_id, t.title AS latest_bug_task_title, (CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS latest_bug_resolved, c.created_by, c.created_at, c.updated_at
WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.id IN #{id} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC

choose.when: CASE WHEN c.latest_by IS NULL OR c.latest_by = '' THEN '__none' ELSE c.latest_by END

mapper.sql: COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'blocked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS blocked, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'skipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS skipped, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS untested
mapper.select:
SELECT AS k,
GROUP BY k

WITH RECURSIVE st AS ( SELECT s.id AS root_id, s.id AS node_id, 1 AS d FROM case_set s WHERE s.workspace_id = #{q.workspaceId} AND s.req_id = #{q.reqId} UNION ALL SELECT st.root_id, c2.id, st.d + 1 FROM case_set c2 JOIN st ON c2.parent_id = st.node_id WHERE st.d < 64 AND c2.workspace_id = #{q.workspaceId} AND c2.req_id = #{q.reqId} ) SELECT t.k, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.st = 'passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.st = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.st = 'blocked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS blocked, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.st = 'skipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS skipped, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.st IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS untested FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT st.root_id AS k, c.id AS cid, c.latest_status AS st FROM test_case c JOIN case_set_item si ON si.case_id = c.id AND si.workspace_id = c.workspace_id JOIN st ON st.node_id = si.set_id JOIN case_set s ON s.id = st.root_id AND s.workspace_id = c.workspace_id LEFT JOIN demand d ON d.id = c.demand_id LEFT JOIN task t ON t.id = c.latest_bug_task_id
AND (s.visibility = 'team' OR s.owner_user_id = #{q.viewerId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM case_set_member sm WHERE sm.set_id = s.id AND sm.user_id = #{q.viewerId})) ) t GROUP BY t.k
SELECT COALESCE(module_id, '__none') AS k, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM test_case WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId} GROUP BY module_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_case WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND module_id = #{moduleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE test_case SET module = #{module} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND module_id = #{moduleId}
UPDATE test_case SET module_id = #{toId}, module = #{module} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND module_id = #{fromId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), -1) FROM test_case WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId}
mapper.update: UPDATE test_case SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT module FROM test_case WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId} AND module IS NOT NULL AND module <> '' ORDER BY module
SELECT title FROM test_case WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT d.id AS demand_id, d.title AS demand_title, d.status AS demand_status, d.priority, COUNT(c.id) AS case_total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'blocked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS blocked, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'skipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS skipped, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL AND c.latest_status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS untested, COUNT(DISTINCT bt.id) AS bug_count FROM demand d LEFT JOIN test_case c ON c.demand_id = d.id AND c.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND c.req_id = d.req_id
WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.req_id = #{reqId} GROUP BY d.id, d.title, d.status, d.priority, d.created_at ORDER BY FIELD(d.status, 'review', 'pass', 'plan', 'closed', 'rej', 'canceled'), d.created_at DESC, d.id

SELECT COUNT(c.id) AS case_total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'blocked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS blocked, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'skipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS skipped, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS untested, COUNT(DISTINCT bt.id) AS bug_count FROM test_case c
WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.req_id = #{reqId} AND (c.demand_id IS NULL OR c.demand_id NOT IN ( SELECT d.id FROM demand d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.req_id = #{reqId} ))
SELECT DISTINCT latest_by FROM test_case WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId} AND latest_by IS NOT NULL AND latest_by <> '' ORDER BY latest_by
SELECT COALESCE(module, '') AS k, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM test_case WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId} GROUP BY module
SELECT COALESCE(priority, '') AS k, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM test_case WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId} GROUP BY priority
SELECT COALESCE(latest_by, '') AS k, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM test_case WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId} GROUP BY latest_by
